zen_torii.notes: Gate: walk through along game Z. Two pillar cylinders (r 0.56, h 7.2) at x=+-2.35 would be the right collider; a single box would block the opening, so none.

zen_lantern.notes: Stone toro lantern; pairs either side of paths, gates and the temple steps.

zen_temple.notes: Hall with veranda; front steps reach game z=+6.3 (toward the player). The box covers the plinth and hall, not the steps or eaves.

zen_pagoda.notes: Five-roof pagoda on an 8 m plinth; eaves reach 5.6 m out. Stand it behind the temple, uphill.

zen_bridge.notes: Taiko drum bridge spanning game X (9 m), deck 2.2 m wide, arch top 1.8 m. Walkable: needs a trimesh or a ramp pair, not a box. Place over a pond; piers go 0.6 m below.

zen_maple_red.notes: Crimson Japanese maple; trunk collider only. Lean over gravel, gates and ponds.

zen_maple_orange.notes: Orange/amber maple with red accents; beside the temple and the fence line.

zen_bamboo.notes: Cluster of 10 culms; repeat in clumps (random yaw) for a dense grove behind fences.

zen_bamboo_fence.notes: 4 m segment along game X; tiles end to end (shared end posts at x=+-2).

zen_shrub.notes: Clipped round shrub; along the fence, the veranda and gravel edges.

zen_azalea.notes: Pink-flowering azalea; pair with zen_shrub, sparingly.

zen_rock_moss.notes: Standing rock; set in the centre gap of zen_gravel_ripples.

zen_rock_low.notes: Low flat-topped mossy rock; ripple centres, pond edges.

zen_gravel_ripples.notes: Ground dressing, 0.12 m max. 2 m central gap for a rock. Lay on flat ground slightly above the terrain (+0.01).

zen_gravel_lines.notes: 10 x 6 m raked rectangle, ridges along game X; tiles end to end along X.

zen_stepping_stones.notes: Five mossy stones on a gentle S-curve along game X; walkable dressing.

zen_terrace_wall.notes: Retaining wall, face toward +Z (the player), 8 m along X; tiles end to end. Terrain behind sits at the 2 m top.

zen_koi.notes: Decorative: pivot is the water surface; fish sit 0.1 m below it. Place at the pond water level, under the water sheet.

zen_temple_steps.notes: 3 m wide, rises 1.5 m over 3 m toward game -Z (bottom step faces +Z). Walkable: use a ramp collider.
